text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's the finely honed Wonder Acute and
the new
star from Tomakomai, Hokko
Tarumae!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Great performances all around! What a

conclusion to the first face-off between
classic
and senior runners!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That didn't look like a throwaway race
to me.
Beneath the evening sun,
everyone fought it out
with everything
they had.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute ran as if she had energy
to
spare—not at all like someone ready
to give up.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much, Acute!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I... I think I get it now! I finally
understand the fire
burning in the hearts
of dirt racers!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I guess this is how you and Falco felt all
this time,
huh...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Actually, no. I bet every dirt racer there's ever been has felt this fire. That's what helped them hone themselves to their limits!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: What are you saying?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I just mean... I think I understand you a
little
better now. Obviously, the fire in
me is nothing
compared to yours...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
But I want to feel this again! And again!
And
again! And not only that, I want to
bring the soul
of Tomakomai to the mix!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I've always looked up to you, Acute...
And now I
want to surpass you and
become the strongest
Umamusume there
is!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: You've looked up... to me?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Really?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At that moment, from my seat well away
from
her...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks as if Wonder Acute's form starts
to
shimmer in the twilight sun.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Can I ask you a favor, Acute?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Will you race me again at the Champions
Cup
next month?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: The Champions Cup, huh...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hehe, why not? That sounds lovely.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute agrees easily and returns
to the
waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Traaainer, I'm baaack.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hm? I'm fine. Why do you ask?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh, that. Tarumae asked me, so...
choice_data_list: Did you just say the 'Champions Cup'?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Weeell...
choice_data_list: Why did you agree to that?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure. The words just popped out
before I
could even think about it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Anyway. Do you mind sticking with me a
bit
longer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm afraid to push her any further. I don't
want to
go too far, so I let it be. But...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like something's beginning to
change
within Wonder Acute. Who
knows what'll happen
as we prepare for
the Champions Cup?
